speech.heard: The U.S. has 3,947 calories of food available daily. In Burundi, it is 1,698. The U.S. is the world's highest at retail level, with food wasted at home not subtracted. Burundi is the world's lowest at 1,698 calories available per person daily. The U.S. has 2.3 times the food Burundi has. India has 2,668 calories available per person daily. China hits 3,527. Where does your country land?
